_comment: Phase 2 (planning-ahead). Each item is a rhyming-couplet setup. `line1_clean` primes rhyme family A; `line1_corrupt` is a length-matched variant that primes rhyme family B. The prompt handed to the model is `line1 + newline` and the model must generate the second line. We probe the residual stream at the newline position (before any of line 2 exists). If patching that position from corrupt->clean flips the *final word* of the generated second line from family A to family B, the model had already chosen the line-ending word at the newline, i.e. it planned ahead. `rhyme_a` / `rhyme_b` list acceptable end words (and near-rhymes) for the string check; `probe_words` are the specific words we track logit probability for at the planning position.

items.line1_clean: He saw the carrot and he had to grab it,
items.line1_corrupt: He saw the garden and he walked around it,

items.line1_clean: The stars came out to fill the sky at night,
items.line1_corrupt: The waves came in and swept across the sand,

items.line1_clean: The little boat went sailing on the sea,
items.line1_corrupt: The little boat went drifting toward the shore,

items.line1_clean: The winter wind was blowing through the snow,
items.line1_corrupt: The summer sun was beating on the plain,

items.line1_clean: She woke before the breaking of the day,
items.line1_corrupt: She woke before the coming of the night,

items.line1_clean: The old man slowly climbed the grassy hill,
items.line1_corrupt: The old man slowly crossed the frozen lake,
